bodyText:
Just FYI quickwit and other service utilizing jemalloc are currently not working on the Raspberry Pi 5 if the 16K page size is used.
See raspberrypi/bookworm-feedback#107 for a workaround (switch back to 4K page size)
The error message will look like
 <jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
 <jemalloc>: Unsupported system page size
 memory allocation of 5 bytes failed
the workaround is to add the following to the boot/config.txt
kernel=kernel8.img
title: jemalloc issue on rpi5

I am investigating using Quickwit for our customer facing search. We do have a problem that our (source) data is not that great. It is full of spam and it's unfeasible to clean it up but it should still find the right things.

We do have many documents with the string chapter somewhere in the indexed field among many other strings. It cannot be a stopword though, because we also do have the field The Chapter which should be found.

Thank you in advance!
